name: cc-tax-system
description: Selected tax-system boundaries for the Cocos (Keeling) Islands, checked in October 2026. Covers Commonwealth and applied Western Australian law, Australian income-tax geography and residence screening, period and currency gates, Medicare, GST connections, excise and local customs controls, and distinct asset-transition conditions. Use for Cocos (Keeling) Islands tax, external territory GST, island imports, mainland dealings or historical asset questions. Includes primary legislation, source-version limits, fictional classification cases and reviewer outputs. This source-cited draft does not calculate a complete liability, establish every local charge or complete the jurisdiction's country pack.
